title: Stock Market
tagline: NEPSE, MeroShare, and capital market tools
description: NEPSE itself does not publish a documented public API — paid feeds run NPR 10k–60k/month. The community has built a thriving ecosystem of unofficial wrappers, scrapers, and IPO bots. The basic-bgnr/NepseUnofficialApi library is foundational; surajrimal07's REST+WebSocket+MCP service is the most feature-rich.
